# Vendored files

Third-party files are kept in the repo so the page loads nothing from other servers.

| File | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jszip.min.js` | JSZip 3.10.1, from cdnjs | MIT or GPLv3 (`jszip.LICENSE.md`) |
| `fonts/bricolage-grotesque-*.woff2` | `@fontsource-variable/bricolage-grotesque` 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/bricolage-grotesque.LICENSE`) |
| `fonts/ibm-plex-*.woff2` | `@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans` and `@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono` 5.x | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/ibm-plex.LICENSE`) |

Only the Latin and Latin Extended subsets are included. Other scripts fall back to system fonts.
